runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
OM B M-25-22 covers new AI contracts starting **180 days after the memo was issued**. The memo is dated April 3, 2025 on its first page, EXECUTIVE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT OFFICE OF MANAGEMENT AND BUDGET WASHINGTON, D .C . 20503 THE DIRECTOR April 3, 2025 M-25-22. Counting 180 days from that date gives about September 30, 2025. That date is my arithmetic, not a figure stated in the document.

The trigger is the solicitation date, not the award date. The memo applies to any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of this memorandum. It also reaches any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after the date that is 180 days after the issuance of this memorandum.

One exclusion applies: This memorandum does not apply to AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.
